bibliographic_source: Virginia Yip and Stephen Matthews. 2000. Basic Cantonese: A Grammar and Workbook. Routledge.
directly_supported_claim: Cantonese 有 can introduce an indefinite NP followed by a predicate, without an overt possessor subject.
exact_example_or_diagnostic: 有(一)個人搵你; 有幾個學生好嬲; 有好多客人嚟咗
project_implication: Use the general positive profile 有 + indefinite NP + NP-linked predicate as AA56's source-backed center.
explicit_limit: The section does not require a locative coda, does not prove all NP or predicate classes productive, and does not analyze 冇人 + predicate as the negative member of the same construction.

bibliographic_source: Charles Lam, Chaak-ming Lau, and Jackson L. Lee. 2024. Multi-Tiered Cantonese Word Segmentation. LREC-COLING 2024, 11993-12002.
directly_supported_claim: When no overt subject precedes 有, 有 may be segmented and analyzed as an existential marker introducing the following noun; that noun is subject of the following predication.
project_implication: Preserve the visible existential marker, introduced nominal, and following predicate; distinguish subjectless introduction from overt-subject possession.
explicit_limit: The paper's primary purpose is segmentation. One example does not establish every presentational subtype, polarity pattern, discourse profile, or parser span.

bibliographic_source: Virginia Yip and Stephen Matthews. 2000. Basic Cantonese: A Grammar and Workbook. Routledge.
directly_supported_claim: An overt place or domain may precede 有 or 冇 plus a nominal in locative-existential clauses.
exact_example_or_diagnostic: 香港有好多的士; 呢度冇洗手間; 枱上面有本書
project_implication: Keep overt place/domain existence in AA77 rather than deleting the place or treating every place-bearing row as subjectless AA56.
explicit_limit: The examples do not settle whether the place is topic, subject, or another syntactic role, and they do not make a post-NP 喺 coda obligatory.

bibliographic_source: Chit-Yu Lam. 2018. On the interaction between negation and aspects in grammaticalization: a cross-linguistic study of three Chinese varieties. Current Research in Chinese Linguistics 97(1): 215-232.
directly_supported_claim: Hong Kong Cantonese 冇 occurs in negative existential, possessive, and aspect-sensitive predicate environments; overt location + 冇 + NP is directly exemplified.
exact_example_or_diagnostic: 課室/課室度 + 冇 + 鉛筆
project_implication: Do not classify all 冇 or all 冇人 + predicate strings as one negative presentational construction; use structural context.
explicit_limit: The source maps the negator's distribution and grammaticalization, not the full information structure of every 冇人 + predicate clause.

bibliographic_source: Canto Span CP021B-R9 existential runtime and source audit.
exact_locator: main.js detector lines 14206-14242; source matrix EPC-C03-EPC-C04
directly_supported_claim: The current runtime AA56 branch recognizes 有/冇 + NP only when a visible 喺/喺度 locative coda follows and exposes positive and negative under one node.
exact_example_or_diagnostic: 有個人喺門口; 冇人喺度
project_implication: Treat the runtime as an implementation aggregate requiring reconciliation with the broader positive source profile and the unsupported negative symmetry.
explicit_limit: Internal behavior is evidence about the parser, not independent evidence about Cantonese grammar or speaker acceptance.

bibliographic_source: Frozen HKCanCor distribution through PyCantonese 5.0.0, complete mechanical inventory and bounded expert review.
exact_locator: 1,372-row inventory; 179-row deterministic packet; complete decisions R1
directly_supported_claim: Natural conversation contains many positive source-compatible 有 + indefinite NP + predicate rows, while 冇人 + predicate overwhelmingly contributes negative human quantification and numerous surface collisions arise from possession, overt places, partitive 有啲, bare existence, temporal phrases, and repairs.
exact_example_or_diagnostic: 有個男仔孭我走喇; 有三個人報串; 有人幫你倒垃圾; 從來冇人講過; 冇人同你講嘢
project_implication: Use corpus evidence to narrow AA56 positively, separate negative-human clauses, and reject token-only or locative-only recognition.
explicit_limit: HKCanCor is one Hong Kong conversational corpus; packet counts are distributional, not productivity estimates, and expert classifications do not replace panel or held-out validation.
